ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  AYM Syntex Limited has filed a routine compliance certificate for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, affirming its adherence to SEBI Regulation 74(5) regarding share dematerialisation processes. The company's Registrar and Share Transfer Agent confirmed that all securities received for dematerialisation were processed correctly, listed, and registered within prescribed timelines. This document indicates standard operational compliance with no material impacts or red flags identified.
